basic_info.description: 21 & 21A Joy Street present a meticulously crafted 1,480 square foot 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom new construction residence complemented by a separate 685 square foot 1-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom auxiliary unit. The main level unfolds with an inviting open layout, featuring expansive living and dining spaces seamlessly integrated with a Chef's kitchen boasting premium appliances, quartz countertops, abundant storage, and a stylish peninsula. Ascend to the upper floor to discover a generously sized primary suite with lush green views, a second ensuite bedroom, a captivating office space offering verdant vistas, and direct access to an impressive roof deck with sweeping views. The lower level introduces the additional dwelling unit, complete with its own deluxe kitchen and sliding doors that open to a spacious south-facing patio with plenty of space for dining and entertaining. Situated on the eastern slope of Bernal Heights, 21 Joy Street enjoys proximity to the vibrant shopping and dining hub along Cortland Avenue and is close to Bernal Heights and Precita Parks. This coveted location provides easy access to the finest attractions of San Francisco, including Oracle Park and Chase Center, plus convenient routes to the Peninsula via Interstate 280 and Highway 101.
